name: silkgrade
description: SilkGrade — AI-assisted colour fastness grading (web app V1, mobile-ready)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @silkgrade/api && npm run build -w @silkgrade/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @silkgrade/shared && npm run test -w @silkgrade/api && npm run test -w @silkgrade/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @silkgrade/api && npm run typecheck -w @silkgrade/web
